annotation.iaa_note: Inter-annotator agreement was not computed because the dataset was validated by a single domain expert. Quality is evidenced by the correction/rejection rate reported below and the annotator's qualifications in NLP and Algerian Arabic.

consent_privacy: No PII collected; seed prompts are synthetic; annotator is also the author.
